mentions.name: WASTE p2p (blackbeltwaste)
mentions.description: This project is work on the WASTE peer-to-peer code base, an old p2p program distributed as the blackbeltwaste SourceForge project. It has recently integrated voice conferencing and is considering adding video-calling, and has been downloaded 15,000 times recently.
mentions.source_excerpt:
We're working on the WASTE p2p code base.

https://sourceforge.net/projects/blackbeltwaste/

Thinking about adding video-calling after successful integration of Voice Conferencing.

Its an old p2p program, but recently been downloaded 15,000 times and counting.
